drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, à hauteur des premières lignes, un cercle tracé à main levée ; du centre partent deux rayons, vers le haut à droite et vers le bas à droite, chacun doublé d'un trait pointillé, et un court trait horizontal portant un point : le secteur $-\theta \leq \arg z \leq +\theta$.
drawings.kind: circle with a sector (two radii and the axis)
drawings.notes: Left margin, beside the first lines. A freehand circle (drawn as a circle fitted to it); from a centre slightly above the middle, two radii to the upper right and to the lower right, ending on computed points of the circle, symmetric about the horizontal; each radius has a row of dots or short dashes beside it, on the side of the sector; a short thin horizontal stroke to the right of the centre, with one dot on it. It is the sector -theta <= arg z <= +theta of the text. Disagreement in part with the note of the transcription (« trois rayons … découpant le disque en trois secteurs, deux des rayons pointillés »): the two oblique radii are solid lines doubled by dots, the third stroke is a short axis that does not reach the circle. Still differs: the upper radius is thin and its dotted double heavy, the lower radius heavy and its dots light; both pairs are drawn alike. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says three radii cutting the disc into three sectors, two of them dotted; the page shows two solid radii, each doubled by a dotted line, and a short horizontal axis with a point, which stops well inside the circle.
